title: Forms and User Input
description: Master advanced form handling patterns including validation, submission, multi-step wizards, and file uploads.
longDescription: Forms are where users interact with your app. This module covers validation, submission with loading states, multi-step wizards, file uploads, and when to reach for form libraries. You'll leave with production-ready form patterns for real-world applications.
whatYouLearn: Validate form inputs and display real-time error messages
Handle async form submission with loading and error states
Build multi-step wizards with progress indicators
Implement file uploads including drag-and-drop zones
